messages:
maria: Heads-up — main pipeline turned red immediately after the merge of PR #6821. Artifact upload step failing with checksum/digest mismatch. @ashwin can you eyeball?
ashwin: On it. Can someone paste the job log or the digest error?
ci-bot: Build #4532 failed on job 'artifact-upload': digest mismatch (expected abc123, got def456). See https://ci.internal/build/4532 
maria: Pasted tail of the job log: ```
Uploading artifact to s3://redwood-artifacts/main/6821.tar.gz
Done. Verifying checksum...
Checksum mismatch: expected abc123 != def456
Aborting upload and marking job failed
```
ashwin: Hmm, that looks like either artifact producer wrote a different file or the upload multipart reassembled wrong. Who merged PR 6821?
kai: I merged it earlier this afternoon. If rerun is cheap we can try first before revert.
devon: Rebuild queued: `/rebuild 4532` (requested by @devon)
ci-bot: Rebuild started for Build #4532 (triggered by devon). Runner: eu-west-1-gpu-12
ashwin: If rebuild reproduces, I can start a bisect on commits touched by the artifact step. First guess: uploader v0.9.2 had a multipart edge-case in our S3 client.
maria: Thanks. If it flakes on rerun, please call for quick revert. Keeping oncall free.
ci-bot: Rebuild completed: failed — same digest mismatch (expected abc123, got def456). Logs at https://ci.internal/build/4532/attempt/2
ashwin: I'll take this. Assigning to myself and starting investigation. First action: reproduce locally with the same artifact producer version and the new uploader binary.
kai: If you want a quick mitigation I can open a revert PR for the uploader bump. Standby.
ashwin: Thanks. I found a failing unit in uploader v0.9.2 when run with multipart chunk size 8MB; confirming now.
devon: Linking draft revert PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/6830 — contains revert of uploader to v0.9.1.
maria: Perfect. Leaving it with ashwin for root cause, kai on standby for revert. :thumbsup:
ashwin: I'll post updates in this thread as I isolate the repro. If anyone sees more CI noise, ping me directly.
